scripts.build:docker: pnpm run build:docker:rpc-cache && pnpm run build:docker:indexer && pnpm run build:docker:indexer-monitor && pnpm run build:docker:frontend && pnpm run build:docker:hasura && pnpm run build:docker:snapshot-gateway && pnpm run build:docker:snapshot-publisher && pnpm run build:docker:snapshot-monitor
scripts.check: turbo run lint:check && biome check . --linter-enabled=false && biome lint tests services/rpc-cache/integration.test.mjs --only=suspicious/noFocusedTests --only=suspicious/noSelfCompare && biome lint scripts/railway-release.cjs --error-on-warnings && pnpm run lint:actions
scripts.dev:indexer: env ENVIO_TUI=false pnpm --dir apps/indexer exec node scripts/start-envio.mjs dev
scripts.dev:indexer:reset: env ENVIO_TUI=false pnpm --dir apps/indexer exec node scripts/start-envio.mjs dev -r
scripts.generate:snapshots:local: pnpm --filter snapshot-publisher run build && env SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/protocol-visualizer-snapshots SNAPSHOT_SOURCE=sample pnpm --filter snapshot-publisher start
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && biome check --write . --linter-enabled=false && biome lint tests services/rpc-cache/integration.test.mjs --only=suspicious/noFocusedTests --only=suspicious/noSelfCompare && biome lint scripts/railway-release.cjs --error-on-warnings && pnpm run lint:actions
scripts.lint:actions: jactionlint --profile correctness --no-online && zizmor --offline --strict-collection --persona auditor --min-severity medium --min-confidence low --collect=workflows --collect=actions .github
scripts.monitor:stack: node scripts/container.mjs compose --profile jobs run --rm snapshot-monitor
scripts.test: turbo run test && pnpm run test:config && env SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/protocol-visualizer-snapshots SNAPSHOT_SOURCE=sample pnpm --filter snapshot-publisher start && pnpm run check:abis
scripts.typecheck: turbo run typecheck && pnpm run check:railway
scripts.up:stack: node scripts/container.mjs compose up --build rpc-cache-postgres rpc-cache postgres hasura minio minio-create-bucket indexer snapshot-gateway frontend
scripts.validate:all: pnpm validate && pnpm validate:images && pnpm test:integration
